en.Arcane Rounds.Name: Arcane Rounds
en.Arcane Rounds.Description:
A small handful of strange rounds, seemingly weightless yet perfectly solid
No known firearm can chamber them, yet some insist they are meant for 'wizard weapons'
You're not sure what that means, but certain individuals—especially that one hoarder with an absurd amount of ammunition—might find them valuable
If you've dealt with her before, you probably know exactly who I'm talking about
en.Pocket Sized Mag of Holding.Name: Pocket Sized Mag of Holding
en.Pocket Sized Mag of Holding.Description:
A strangely shaped container that holds far more ammo than it should
Despite looking like a regular magazine, it refuses to fit into any weapon
Some SCAV found it buried in a stash, thinking he scored the ultimate high-capacity mag
When he tried to use it, the rounds simply vanished instead of feeding into the chamber
Frustrated, he tossed it aside-only to realize later that it still worked as a magazine, just not in the way he expected
It became the go-to pouch for stashing extra ammo
en.Mystic Rounds.Name: Mystic Rounds
en.Mystic Rounds.Description:
These bullets don't make any sense
They feel real, yet flicker between existing and not existing when you aren't looking directly at them
Some say they're used in weapons powered by forces beyond comprehension, but considering no gun in Tarkov can fire them, you remain skeptical
However, there is someone-an eccentric collector with an almost supernatural obsession for ammo-who might want these in exchange for something… unusual
en.Satchel Sized Mag of Holding.Name: Satchel Sized Mag of Holding
en.Satchel Sized Mag of Holding.Description:
This oddly proportioned ammo container defies all logic
It holds an absurd amount of rounds, yet weighs almost nothing when empty
A SCAV scavenged it from an abandoned hideout, convinced it was some experimental military prototype
After forcing it into a rifle, he found that the bullets stored inside refused to chamber-just vanishing instead
While utterly useless as a firearm mag, it proved to be an excellent way to carry extra ammo
en.Eldritch Rounds.Name: Eldritch Rounds
en.Eldritch Rounds.Description:
A terrifyingly large stack of bizarre ammunition, completely unfathomable in function
Some claim these are 'magic bullets' for weapons wielded by spellcasters, but no amount of testing has proven their use
While most traders laugh them off as nonsense, there is one 'person' in Tarkov-someone who knows ammo better than anyone-who might just trade you something extraordinary for them
You know who I mean
en.Crate Sized Mag of Holding.Name: Crate Sized Mag of Holding
en.Crate Sized Mag of Holding.Description:
An enormous, ridiculously spacious ammo container shaped like an oversized magazine
It defies weight, space, and common sense, capable of holding entire arsenals of different kinds of ammunition
Some SCAV discovered it in a ruined warehouse and, assuming it was a drum mag for some foreign weapon, tried loading it into his weapon
When the gun refused to reload, he gave up, only to realize later that he could still use it to store his ammo, just not the way he originally intended
en.Cluster Bomb Fragment.Name: Cluster Bomb Fragment
en.Cluster Bomb Fragment.Description: Part of Amonya mod. It is fragment for Cluster Bomb ammo variant
en.VariantDescription1: Can be used only in {caliberInfo.Name} caliber weapon of types:
en.Armor-cracking.Name: Armor-cracking
en.Armor-cracking.FlavourText: Engineered to shred through ceramic and steel, leaving protection meaningless and enemies with fear
en.Armor-cracking.Description: A high-penetration round with double armor damage. Excellent against heavy armor, but comes with drastically reduced damage output
en.Armor-cracking.Explanation: Designed for neutralizing heavily armored opponents. Best used in combination with anti-personnel rounds for maximum efficiency
en.Bloody.Name: Bloody
en.Bloody.FlavourText: A cruel round designed to leave enemies bleeding out long after impact
en.Bloody.Description: Guaranteed light bleeding, with a 50% chance of heavy bleeding with slightly decreased penetration power. Virtually useless against armor
en.Bloody.Explanation: Effective against unarmored or high-health targets, especially when time is on your side
en.Heavy Duty.Name: Heavy Duty
en.Heavy Duty.FlavourText: Engineered for sharpshooters who demand maximum punch at any range
en.Heavy Duty.Description: Extremely fast, high-penetration ammunition with boosted damage and armor damage. Comes at the cost of heavy recoil
en.Heavy Duty.Explanation: Best used with DMRs and sniper rifles, but usable in other weapons if you can handle increased recoil
en.Anti-personnel.Name: Anti-personnel
en.Anti-personnel.FlavourText: A predator's choice. Made to punish the weak and unarmored
en.Anti-personnel.Description: High-damage round with minimal penetration. No armor damage and no bleeding chance
en.Anti-personnel.Explanation: Optimized for use against lightly armored targets. Pairs well with armor-cracking ammunition in belts for versatility
en.Full-auto.Name: Full-auto
en.Full-auto.FlavourText: Cheap, reliable, and made for spraying down a room without draining your wallet!
en.Full-auto.Explanation: A budget-friendly choice for full-auto weapons, balancing cost and control at the expense of damage
en.Railgun.Name: Railgun
en.Railgun.FlavourText: A coin flipped by lightning itself, tearing through the battlefield faster than sound
en.Railgun.Description: Explosive round with high initial speed
en.Railgun.Explanation: A high-end prototype capable of lethal impact even near the target. Extremely powerful but prohibitively expensive
en.Artillery.Name: Artillery
en.Artillery.FlavourText: "The most hated tank type in certain game"
en.Artillery.Description: Explosive bullet with low initial speed allowing you to shoot enemies behind cover
en.Artillery.Explanation: Specialized High-explosive bullet to kill enemies behind covers or call an artillery strike on boss position
en.Mortar.Name: Mortar
en.Mortar.Description: Explosive bullet with very low initial speed allowing you to shoot enemies even behind buildings
en.Mortar.Explanation: Specialized High-explosive bullet to kill enemies behind covers or call an artillery strike on boss position
en.Avada Kedavra.Name: Avada Kedavra
en.Avada Kedavra.Description: Bullet that will 1-hit your enemy but with low initial speed
en.Avada Kedavra.Explanation: Specialized bullet with 1-hit potencial only for Bolt-action rifles, if you can deal with relatively low initial bullet speed
en.Pro+.Name: Pro+
en.Pro+.FlavourText: With Amonya+ subscription you can gain access to special Pro+ bullet type that is simply better than the regular ones
en.Pro+.Description: Bullet with slightly increased damage and penetration without chance to deal a bleeding
en.Pro+.Explanation: Just the best bullet in the game
en.Hypersonic.Name: Hypersonic
en.Hypersonic.FlavourText: Fast bullets means that your enemy will be dead faster? Is that right?
en.Hypersonic.Description: Bullet with insane initial speed but with increased recoil
en.Hypersonic.Explanation: Normal bullet with insane initial speed for easier hitting enemies on long distances or in motion
en.Flamethrower.Name: Flamethrower
en.Flamethrower.FlavourText: Fire that hurts a lot, but you can outrun it
en.Flamethrower.Description: Big bullet with low initial-speed but with increased damage
en.Flamethrower.Explanation: Specialised bullet ideally for use on short distances and stationary targets
en.Close Quarters.Name: Close Quarters
en.Close Quarters.FlavourText: Someone put all the close quarters ideas in one casing and here it is!
en.Close Quarters.Description: Bullet that always penetrates obstacles, always ricochets, is bigger and have increased damage and penetration but with lowered initial speed and accuracy
en.Close Quarters.Explanation: Good early-game bullet with good penetration and damage, if you can deal with low initial speed
en.Rubber Grenade.Name: Rubber Grenade
en.Rubber Grenade.FlavourText: Grenade that is not explosive, but hurts very much
en.Rubber Grenade.Description: Grenade missing explosive component but with increased velocity, penetration and damage
en.Rubber Grenade.Explanation: Normal bullet for 40x46 grenade launchers if you can deal with aiming it in proper way
en.Sabot.Name: Sabot
en.Sabot.FlavourText: It's a slug, but on a diet. Goes fast, hates armor, and has unresolved anger issues
en.Sabot.Description: A high-speed sabot slug designed to penetrate armor with precision, but has lower damage
en.Sabot.Explanation: Shotgun slug to use on long distances
en.Tazer.Name: Tazer
en.Tazer.FlavourText: Shock your enemies... or your dog, I don't care!
en.Tazer.Description: Bullet with low initial speed, very low range but with increadibly good damage
en.Tazer.Explanation: Speciallised bullet that will decimate your enemy if it gets too close to you
en.Ratshot.Name: Ratshot
en.Ratshot.FlavourText: A specialized cartridge loaded with tiny pellets designed for pest control and close-quarters fun. Useless against armor, terrifying against rats.
en.Ratshot.Description: Buckshot bullet for normal guns. Features almost no penetration and armor damage, small initial speed and bullet, low accuracy but with lowered heat buildup and recoil. It's dirt cheep!
en.Ratshot.Explanation: Almost free bullet for early-game ratting
en.Laser.Name: Laser
en.Laser.FlavourText: Of course it is shooting lasers! Why it should not?
en.Laser.Description: Bullet variant with very good speed and penetration but lowered damage
en.Laser.Explanation: Low damage-high speed bullet for low caliber weapon efficient on long distance fights
en.Ratshot Mk2.Name: Ratshot Mk2
en.Ratshot Mk2.FlavourText: A specialized cartridge loaded with tiny pellets designed for pest control and close-quarters fun. Useless against armor, terrifying against rats.
en.Ratshot Mk2.Description: Buckshot bullet that features low penetration and armor damage, small initial speed and bullet, low accuracy but with lowered heat buildup and recoil
en.Ratshot Mk2.Explanation: Buckshot bullet for normal guns. In addition, it is very cost-efficient!
en.Heavy.Name: Heavy
en.Heavy.FlavourText: A buckshot shell loaded with fewer, larger pellets. Each pellet carries greater stopping power, but fewer projectiles reduce the spread and coverage
en.Heavy.Description: Buckshot bullet that features halfed the number of pellets, but tripled damage and increased penetration
en.Heavy.Explanation: Good buckshot bullet on close-range engagements but is very pricey
en.Light.Name: Light
en.Light.FlavourText: A buckshot cartridge loaded with hardened pellets and a boosted powder charge, designed for extremely high muzzle velocity
en.Light.Description: Buckshot bullet that features tripled initial speed but decreased number of pellets and lowered damage
en.Light.Explanation: Buckshot bullet effective against lightly armored targets on medium distances
en.Mini-nuke.Name: Mini-nuke
en.Mini-nuke.Explanation: Definitely a big boom. Low initial speed and long fuze time included!
en.Cluster Bomb.Name: Cluster Bomb
en.Cluster Bomb.FlavourText: Shoot it into corridor and watch your frames drop. Shoot it into the window and your PC will explode!
en.Cluster Bomb.Description: Grenade variant without fuze time, but having multiple high-explosive fragments after initial detonation
en.Cluster Bomb.Explanation: This can kill multiple targets close by and inside of bulding. But keep in mind the explosive fragments that can kill you too
en.Afterburner.Name: Afterburner
en.Afterburner.FlavourText: Everyone is wishing for more fire in their lives!
en.Afterburner.Description: A high-velocity round that sacrifices raw damage for increased penetration, higher muzzle velocity and significantly higher heat buildup
en.Afterburner.Explanation: A budget-friendly option for most weapons, as an alternative to Full-auto rounds
en.Spiked.Name: Spiked
en.Spiked.FlavourText:
- Do you know of that little animal, with spikes, what is it called... ?
- Hedgehog? Porcupine?
- Huh? Ohh, yes... that one!
- And what is wrong with it?
- See this bullet? It is like an explosive porcupine!
en.Spiked.Description: A grenade round with no explosive damage, instead dispersing lethal 12.7x108mm BZT-44M projectiles upon detonation
en.Spiked.Explanation: Functions as a fragmentation trap. Anyone caught in its line of sight during detonation risks severe or lethal injury
en.Mini-rocket.Name: Mini-rocket
en.Mini-rocket.FlavourText: It's a bird! It's a plane! It's a... slug? *kaboom*
en.Mini-rocket.Description: Explosive shotgun slug inspired by the 30x29mm VOG-30 grenade, with slightly reduced explosive performance
en.Mini-rocket.Explanation: The fourth bullet type of explosive ammunition for normal weapons. Offers higher velocity and improved effective range compared to other variants, but suffers from reduced accuracy by being able to be used only by limited number of weapon categories
en.Lucky Shot.Name: Lucky Shot
en.Lucky Shot.FlavourText: At close range, you're lucky. At long range, you'd better hope you are
en.Lucky Shot.Description: A buckshot round designed for bolt-action rifles. Accuracy becomes a gamble - you might miss entirely or land multiple hits in a single shot
en.Lucky Shot.Explanation: Devastating at close range. At medium to long distances, effectiveness becomes unpredictable due to pellet spread
en.Introduction:Lore:
Surviving in Tarkov is no simple task for Amonya, a creature who was never meant to appear here. A mistake in a complex spell cast by her unicorn grandfather pulled her into this place. At first, she wanted only to return home, but instead of finding a way back, she learned how to hide. A black cloak conceals her unnaturally white mane, and she found joy in gathering all kinds of ammunition and even creating a new types. In time, she even found a trusted partner: you.

Now, after all the experience she has gained, Amonya has chosen to stay. She intends to take revenge on those who crossed her path and made her struggle in this land. This quiet pony values her beloved piles of ammunition, yet her hatred for her enemies runs even deeper. Eliminate them, bring her items useful to her life, and she will reward you with her ammo reserves. Amonya may even share experimental variants of ammunition that could aid you in your escape from Tarkov.
